connectionType.label: Connection type
connectionType.help: Select how the Modbus RTU connection is connected to ioBroker.

host.label: Gateway IP / hostname
host.help: IP address or hostname of the transparent TCP-to-RS485 gateway.

port.label: TCP port
port.help: TCP port of the transparent TCP-to-RS485 gateway.

tcpGatewayInfo.label: Required gateway settings
tcpGatewayInfo.text: Transparent TCP-to-RS485 gateway required. Serial settings: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, parity None, 1 stop bit, no flow control. Use TCP Server mode and Protocol = None / transparent mode. Tested example: Waveshare Ethernet-to-RS485 gateway. For the tested Waveshare setup, RS485 Conflict Time Gap = 5 ms is used. Do not enable Modbus TCP-to-RTU conversion.

serialDevice.label: USB / Serial device
serialDevice.help: Linux serial device, for example /dev/ttyUSB0 or /dev/ttyACM0.

serialInfo.label: USB / Serial settings
serialInfo.text: Fixed settings: 9600 baud, 8 data bits, parity None, 1 stop bit, no flow control. Direct USB-to-RS485 support is implemented and currently considered experimental.

slaveId.label: Modbus slave ID
slaveId.help: Default is 1. Change only if the heat pump uses another Modbus address.

fallbackPollingEnabled.label: Fallback active polling
fallbackPollingEnabled.help: Enable only when passive Modbus data is not received reliably. Active polling is used only when passive data is missing.

fallbackPollingInterval.label: Fallback polling interval
fallbackPollingInterval.help: Interval in seconds between fallback checks. Recommended: 60 seconds.
